entity_geography.text: A 2026 02 OP - Development and maintenance of learning products for the EU Agency for Railways Annex 3: Standard forms The standard forms are to be completed and provided as part of your offer. Identification of the tenderer : Business Partner Form The tenderer (or the single point of contact in case of joint tender) must provide a Business Partner Form and supporting documents. This panel competition is for the provision of Entrepreneurship Training Services to support the ARC Hub for ICT, TU Dublin. The panel will be used to appoint suitably qualified service providers to deliver structured entrepreneurship training to publicly funded ICT translational research teams. Overview of Requirements 2.1 About the ARC Hub for ICT The ARC Hub for ICT has been established to create a thriving entrepreneurial pathway for Irish ICT research, with a vision of connecting academic research outputs to innovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT re

ovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT research outputs ready for translation. The Hub will support both centre-affiliated and independent researchers across Ireland, thanks to its collaborative structure with multiple universities, technological universities, and partner organisations. It acts as a pre-commercialisation platform, enabling researchers to build skills, secure funding, and develop prototypes before moving on to full-scale entrepreneurial ventures. The ARC Hub for ICT has identified five thematic pillars with the highest potential for growth and societal impact. should follow international best practice (UK/US university–entrepreneur models) across three key stages and is structured to equip research teams with the skills to bring innovations to market. 2.2 Training Programme Overview The Training Programme supports translational research teams in progressing innovations from concept validation through customer validation to spin-out formation. The programme includes three key stages: - Stage 1: Value Proposition Development - Stage 2a: Customer Validation and Business Model Development - Stage 3: Spinning Out The successful Panel Member will facilitate, deliver and report on all activities and outputs associated with these stages, in collaboration with the Spin-Out Manager and ARC Hub operations team. The programme is designed to build entrepreneurial capability, validate commercial potential and prepare suitable projects for spin‑out formation or licensing. 2.3 Expected Learning Outcomes On completion of the programme, participants will be expected to demonstrate understanding and practical application of: Value proposition development Customer discovery Lean business model canvas Minimum viable products (MVPs) Technology readiness levels (TRLs) Problem Solution Fit Market validation Term Sheet Capitalization Table Spin‑out formation

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

entity_geography.text: itoring, Evaluation, Learning and Communications support to the GIZ Eastern Caribbean portfolio of projects Region: Caribbean Procedure type: Open procedure Invitation to submit a tender Dear Sir/Madam, Thank you for your interest in this procurement procedure. The German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) has commissioned us to implement the above project. Against this background, Section 3.2 of the General Terms and Conditions of Contract governing legislation on public sector pricing applies. The project also aims to expand ABS-related mechanisms of the Caribbean biodiversity strategy and promote the development of a regional IT system for ABS approval. To achieve this, the capacities of the staff responsible for setting up, operating (e.g. ABS Focal Points) and maintaining the IT system will be developed. This will allow incoming research requests for genetic resources to be centrally managed and approved, to ensure they follow a standard format when submitted to the ABS Clearing-House (Internationally Recognized Certificate of Compliance). To complement the IT system, capacity development will also extend to strengthening the expertise of technical staff in ABS contract negotiations and to providing legal advice to the competent authorities on drafting ABS legislation. The output builds on the preliminary work of the ABS initiative in the Bahamas and on the skills of OECS office staff in St. Lucia, some of whom have already received training, thereby enhancing efficiency. However, a strategic approach to strengthening visibility and recognition of BMZ funded and GIZ implemented initiatives in the Caribbean region has been identified as a gap that needs to be addressed. Currently, GIZ Caribbean has limited communication and visibility processes at a portfolio level, with projects communicating through their individual channels. In 2023, an internal “Regional Communication Group ” was establish ed but discontinued due to a lack of engagement and communication personnel. Currently, t wo projects have dedicated communication staff, while others rely on team members with additional responsibilities. Communication strategies vary, with some projects following structured plans while others lack clear guidelines. Existing projects produce fact sheets, short videos, and awareness campaigns, with varying levels of consistency and adherence to GIZ corporate identity guidelines. The GIZ Caribbean webpage (https://www.giz.de/en/regions/latin-america- caribbean/caribbean) is managed by the Corporate Communications Department at Headquarters in Germany and provides basic thematic information in English and German, as well as links to the external GIZ project websites. Context The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH is a service provider in the field of international cooperation for sustainable development and international education work, with worldwide operations on behalf of the German Government and other commissioning parties. GIZ supports change processes in developing countries and emerging economies by providing tailor -made, cost -efficient, and effective services for sustainable development. The Ge

l organizations, national governments, civil society, and the private sector to address global challenges and achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Within the Caribbean, BMZ has prioritized climate resilience, environmental sustainability, and inclusive economic transformation, channeling these commitments into regional programming supported by GIZ. The Caribbean region faces persistent and interrelated problems that demand urgent attention and evidence -based solutions. Climate change impacts —including more intense hurricanes, sea -level rise, saltwater intrusion, and coastal erosion —pose existential risks to small island states. Marine and terrestrial biodiversity are under pressure from unsustainable practices, habitat loss, and pollution, while waste management systems remain inadequate. Energy systems are overly dependent on fossil fuels, exposing economies to high cost s and volatility. Meanwhile, high youth unemployment and underdeveloped technical skills restrict economic opportunity and undermine resilience. Together, these challenges threaten sustainable development pathways and highlight the critical need for effective, integrated, and responsive programming. sla_onsite.text: per 5 darbo dienas pakeisti šį ūkio subjektą reikalavimus atitinkančiu. SUBTIEKĖJŲ, KURIŲ PAJĖGUMAIS TIEKĖJAS NESIREMIA, PASITELKIMAS Tiekėjas, teikiantis pasiūlymą savarankiškai arba kaip ūkio subjektų grupės dalyvis, turi nurodyti, subtiekėjus, jeigu jie yra žinomi, ir kokiai pirkimo Sutarties daliai, jis ketina pasitelkti. Subtiekėjai, kuriuos tiekėjas pasitelks pirkimo sutarties vykdymui, privalo turėti teisę verstis ta veikla, kuriai jis pasitelkiamas. Pirkimo vykdytojas netikrina, ar nėra subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų, jeigu SS nenurodyta kitaip. Jei teisės aktai numato pareigą apdrausti pagal konkrečią pirkimo sutartį teikiamas paslaugas, atliekamus darbus ir pan. ir numatoma, tiekėjas įsipareigoja užtikrinti, kad bus pasitelkiami ir pirkimo sutartį vykdys tik tokią teisę turintys subtiekėjai ir pirkimo vykdytojui pareikalavus, tiekėjas pateiks dokumentus, įrodančius subtiekėjų atitiktį šiam reikalavimui. Tuo atveju, jei pasiūlymo pateikimo metu tiekėjui nebuvo žinomi subtiekėjai, sudarius pirkimo sutartį, tačiau ne vėliau negu pirkimo sutartis pradedama vykdyti, tiekėjas įsipareigoja perkančiajai organizacijai pranešti tuo metu žinomų subtiekėjų pavadinimus, kontaktinius duomenis ir jų atstovus. Tiekėjas privalo informuoti apie minėtos informacijos pasikeitimus visą Su

. Kartu su informacija apie keičiamus pasiūlyme nurodytus subtiekėjus, kuriems buvo keliami kvalifikaciniai reikalavimai ar tikrinama, ar nėra subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų, pateikiami ir subtiekėjo pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą (supaprastintų pirkimų atveju – reikalaujama tik tuomet, kai perkančioji organizacija turi pagrįstų abejonių dėl jo patikimumo), kvalifikaciją patvirtinantys dokumentai. Subtiekėjo pasitelkimas nekeičia tiekėjo atsakomybės dėl numatomos sudaryti Sutarties įvykdymo, todėl bet kokiu atveju tiekėjas pilnai prisiima atsakomybę už subtiekėjų veiklą vykdant Sutartį. Tiesioginis atsiskaitymas su subtiekėjais, prekių ar paslaugų pirkimo atveju, nebus vykdomas, jeigu SS nenurodyta kitaip. Rangos darbų pirkimo atveju, tiekėjo pasitelktiems subtiekėjams yra suteikiama galimybė prašyti PO tiesiogiai atsiskaityti su jais: 8.7.1. Subtiekėjas, norintis pasinaudoti tiesioginio atsiskaitymo galimybe, įvykdęs įsipareigojimus pagal sutartį, pateikia prašymą PO kartu su tiekėjo patvirtinimu, kad subtiekėjas tinkamai atliko savo įsipareigojimus pagal sutartį, ir, kad tiekėjas neturi prieštaravimų tiesioginiam atsiskaitymui su subtiekėju. 8.7.2. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. A services officer is required for 35 hours per week across Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays) on site at the HRB offices. The HRB has an accessible premises at Grattan House, 67- 72 Lower Mount Street, Dublin 2 and has offices across floors 0-3 within this building. Common areas within the building including toilets, lifts and the foyer are the responsibility of the landlord and are not covered in this tender. There are over 120 staff employed by the HRB although not all will be expected in the building together at any one time. Please note tenderers must be able to provide both managed services – cleaning services and services officer and cannot opt to respond to one element of the RFT. Voor de aanwijzing van de economisch meest voordelige regelmatige offerte wordt rekening gehouden met onder vermelde gunningscriteria: Criterium 1: Het offertebedrag (50 punten) De prijsvergelijking tussen de verschillende offertes zal gebeuren op basis van het totale offertebedrag opgegeven door de inschrijvers. Er wordt in de bijlage 3 van dit bestek een inventaris voorzien. De inschrijvers dienen voor elke post met eenheidsprijs die in de inventaris is opgenomen DMOW/MT/03115 Pagina 13 van 65 verplicht een prijs in te vullen. Indien niet alle prijzen in de inventaris worden opgenomen, kan de aanbestedende overheid niet vergelijken met andere indieners en dus niet beoordelen op de prijs. De bepaling van de scores gebeurt als volgt: Aan de laagste regelm

satie van expertise binnen het voorgestelde CAAS-model. De puntentoekenning gebeurt uitsluitend in gehele punten. Er worden geen cijfers na de komma toegekend. Puntentoekenning kwaliteitscriterium 3: Kwalitatieve score Punten (max. 20) 0 0 / 20 1 2 / 20 2 5 / 20 3 10 / 20 4 15 / 20 5 20 / 20 Alle documentatie voor dit criterium wordt in één afzonderlijk .pdf document (met zoek mogelijkheden, document afgedrukt als .pdf, geen scan van document) bij de offerte gevoegd. Het document wordt gestructureerd opgesteld, rekening houdend met voorgaande. Eindbeoordeling economisch voordelige offerte De puntenscores van alle gunningscriteria voor de opdracht worden bij mekaar opgeteld om zo de rangorde van de offertes op te stellen. De hoogste totaalscore bepa alt de economisch meest voordelige offerte. De punten voor het prijscriterium worden berekend volgens de in het bestek vastgelegde formule en kunnen decimalen bevatten. De punten voor de kwaliteitscriteria worden toegekend in gehele punten. De totaalscore is de som van beide en wordt vastgesteld zonder afronding. DMOW/MT/03115 Pagina 17 van 65 C. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2. Fourniture d’un logiciel ou d’un développement sur mesure L’adjudicataire doit utiliser un environnement de développement sécurisé pour la conception de son logiciel afin que celui-ci ne soit pas le point d’entrée pour atteindre les systèmes de l’ETNIC et/ou de ses bénéficiaires (par l’insertion de codes malveillants, par exemple). Il est demandé d’appliquer les exigences et les recommandations de sécurité minimales, comme notamment les règles de sécurisation des équipements (durcissement des configurations, gestion des vulnérabilités, interfaces de connexion, équipements mobiles, sécurité des consoles de programmation, des stations d’ingénierie et des postes d’administration). The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. sla_onsite.text: itos PD vartojamos sąvokos suprantamos taip, kaip jos apibrėžtos VPĮ, Lietuvos Respublikos konkurencijos įstatyme, Metodikoje ar kituose viešųjų pirkimų teisinius santykius reglamentuojančiuose teisės aktuose. PD sudaro: Bendrosios sąlygos (BS) 1 [šis dokumentas]; Specialiosios sąlygos (SS) 2; Techninė specifikacija (TS) 3; Pasiūlymo forma (PF) 4; Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas (EBVPD) 5; Forma dėl kvalifikacijos (FK) 6 [jei taikoma]; Paaiškinimai ir/arba patikslinimai [teikiami Komisijos pagal poreikį]; Skelbimas apie pirkimą; Skelbimai dėl pakeitimų [jei taikoma]; Išankstinis skelbimas apie numatomus pirkimus [jei taikoma]; Paslaugų sutarties bendrosios ir specialiosios sąlygos 7; Nacionalinio saugumo reikalavimų atitikties deklaracija 8 [jei taikoma]; Tiekėjo deklaracija dėl Tarybos Reglamente (ES) 2022/576 nustatytų sąlygų nebuvimo 9 [jei taikoma]. Tuo atveju, kai tikslinama pirkimo skelbime paskelbta informacija, atitinkamai patikslinamas skelbimas ir prireikus pratęsiamas pasiūlymų pateikimo terminas protingumo kriterijų atitinkančiu laikotarpiu, per kurį tiekėjai, rengdami pasiūlymus, galėtų atsižvelgti į patikslinimus. Savanoriškas ex ante skaidrumo skelbimas neskelbiamas. Pirkimas atliekamas vadovaujantis: VPĮ, šiais PD, kitais viešuosius pirkimus reglamentuoj

ustatytą terminą pakeisti šį ūkio subjektą reikalavimus atitinkančiu. SUBTIEKĖJŲ, KURIŲ PAJĖGUMAIS TIEKĖJAS NESIREMIA, PASITELKIMAS Tiekėjas, teikiantis pasiūlymą savarankiškai arba kaip ūkio subjektų grupės dalyvis, turi nurodyti, subtiekėjus, jeigu jie yra žinomi, ir kokiai pirkimo Sutarties daliai, jis ketina juos pasitelkti. Subtiekėjai, kuriuos tiekėjas pasitelks pirkimo sutarties vykdymui, privalo turėti teisę verstis ta veikla, kuriai jie pasitelkiami. Pirkimo vykdytojas netikrina, ar nėra subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų, jeigu SS nenurodyta kitaip. Jei teisės aktai numato pareigą apdrausti pagal konkrečią pirkimo sutartį teikiamas paslaugas, atliekamus darbus ir pan., tiekėjas įsipareigoja užtikrinti, kad bus pasitelkiami ir pirkimo sutartį vykdys tik tokią teisę turintys subtiekėjai ir pirkimo vykdytojui pareikalavus, tiekėjas pateiks dokumentus, įrodančius subtiekėjų atitiktį šiam reikalavimui. Tuo atveju, jei pasiūlymo pateikimo metu tiekėjui nebuvo žinomi subtiekėjai, tiekėjas po Sutarties įsigaliojimo įsipareigoja, ne vėliau kaip likus 2 (dviem) darbo dienoms iki sutarties etapo, kurio veiklas vykdys subtiekėjas, vykdymo pradžios, perkančiajai organizacijai pranešti tuo metu žinomų subtiekėjų pavadinimus, kontaktinius duomenis ir jų atstovus. Tiekėjas privalo informuo

ius duomenis ir jų atstovus. Tiekėjas privalo informuoti apie minėtos informacijos pasikeitimus visą Sutarties vykdymo laikotarpį. Kartu su informacija apie keičiamus pasiūlyme nurodytus subtiekėjus, kuriems buvo keliami kvalifikaciniai reikalavimai ar tikrinama, ar nėra subtiekėjų pašalinimo pagrindų, pateikiami ir subtiekėjo pašalinimo pagrindų nebuvimą, kvalifikaciją patvirtinantys dokumentai. Subtiekėjo pasitelkimas nekeičia tiekėjo atsakomybės dėl numatomos sudaryti Sutarties įvykdymo, todėl bet kokiu atveju tiekėjas pilnai prisiima atsakomybę už subtiekėjų veiklą vykdant Sutartį. Tiesioginis atsiskaitymas su subtiekėjais, prekių ar paslaugų pirkimo atveju, nebus vykdomas, jeigu SS nenurodyta kitaip. Rangos darbų pirkimo atveju, tiekėjo pasitelktiems subtiekėjams yra suteikiama galimybė prašyti PO tiesiogiai atsiskaityti su jais: 7.7.1. Subtiekėjas, norintis pasinaudoti tiesioginio atsiskaitymo galimybe, įvykdęs įsipareigojimus pagal sutartį, pateikia prašymą PO kartu su tiekėjo patvirtinimu, kad subtiekėjas tinkamai atliko savo įsipareigojimus pagal sutartį, ir, kad tiekėjas neturi prieštaravimų tiesioginiam atsiskaitymui su subtiekėju. 7.7.2. PO, išnagrinėjusi subtiekėjo prašymą, priima sprendimą dėl tokio atsiskaitymo taikymo bei praneša tiekėjui ir subtiekėjui per 14 (ket

imams. VPĮ 39 straipsnio 5 dalyje nustatytais atvejais Komisija nereikalauja iš tiekėjo pateikti SS nustatytų dokumentų, patvirtinančių atitiktį įstatymo 37 straipsnio 9 dalies reikalavimams [jeigu taikoma, žr. TS]. Taip pat Komisija gali nereikalauti VPĮ 39 straipsnio 3 dalyje nurodytų dokumentų, jeigu iš kitų šaltinių, negu nurodyta VPĮ 39 straipsnio 5 dalyje, gali nustatyti pasiūlymo atitiktį keliamiems reikalavimams. Komisija įvertina: ar pasiūlymas atitinka PD nustatytus bendruosius reikalavimus, ar teisingai ir pagal PD reikalavimus pateikta PF; ar pasiūlymas atitinka PD nustatytus techninius reikalavimus, ar tiekėjas siūlo prekes, paslaugas ar darbus atitinkančius techninės specifikacijos reikalavimus; ar nėra pasiūlyme nurodytos kainos ar sąnaudų apskaičiavimo klaidų. Nustačiusi pasiūlyme nurodytos kainos ar sąnaudų apskaičiavimo klaidas, Komisija atitinkamai paprašys tiekėjo per jo nurodytą terminą ištaisyti pasiūlyme pastebėtas aritmetines klaidas. Pasiūlymo vertinimo metu nustatytos kainos ar sąnaudų apskaičiavimo klaidos privalo būti ištaisytos per pirkimo vykdytojo nurodytą terminą, nekeičiant susipažinimo su pasiūlymais metu užfiksuotos kainos ar sąnaudų, vadovaujantis Viešųjų pirkimų tarnybos direktoriaus 2022 m. gruodžio 30 d. įsakymu Nr. 1S-240 patvirtintomis Pasi

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re
